goal: Fix node crashes from assertion failures when loading a wallet while the chain tip is advancing
Ensure missing blocks are scanned before evaluating transaction confirmation states
Prevent confirmed transactions from being incorrectly treated as abandoned
reviewability: Author silent for 78 days; reviews may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Blocked by unaddressed correctness objections with no author reply (l0rinc, cprkrn)
Unaddressed objection: reverse iteration may violate transaction dependency ordering (l0rinc)
Unaddressed objection: node aborts when loading a wallet after a reorged coinbase spend (cprkrn)
Tested and approved for eliminating the loading race condition (shuv-amp, dergoegge, pablomartin4btc)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it prevents node assertion crashes caused by inconsistent transaction states on startup
Avoids incorrectly marking confirmed transactions as abandoned during catch-up
